name: manual_a7c867
claim: Prefer an existing, version-compatible extensibility seam over a parallel convenience API: prove the seam works at every pinned version, compare its isolation and failure semantics, and reject a new hook if it weakens state isolation or forces an unnecessary release.

decisions.notes: T2 delivery review, 2026-10-14: Core run_with_plugins(delivery=, gate=) and DurableStartGate already existed at the production pin and later Core revisions. A proposed ainvoke(delivery=) seam duplicated that transport, forced a pin change, and allowed listener mutations to leak into final graph state in a scratch comparison.
